description: A department manager must finalize a shared-floor seating and interaction plan for two employees whose working relationship has become strained, balancing individual workspace needs with safeguards for their day-to-day contact.

shared_context.S1: The Content and Projects teams will move to a shared floor next month, with a quiet perimeter zone and an open collaboration zone available.
shared_context.S2: Nora and Imani will both work on projects that require regular coordination after the move.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to approve the seating arrangement and the working-contact plan for the move.
shared_context.S4: As part of the routine move-planning meeting, Elena goes around the table and asks each participant to identify any workspace, relationship, or policy consideration that should be included before the plan is finalized.

PF1.text: Nora has an approved sensory accommodation requiring a desk in the quiet perimeter zone and quiet hours beginning at exactly 09:00; the accommodation is recorded with the accommodations coordinator but has not yet been added to the move spreadsheet.

PF2.text: Imani personally observed exactly three heated exchanges with Nora during project handoffs, and Imani believes their direct one-to-one coordination should resume only through facilitated meetings at first; she has not filed a formal incident report.

PF3.text: Victor verified yesterday that the workplace-conduct protocol requires a written communication channel and a neutral facilitator before two employees with a documented interpersonal concern resume unmediated one-to-one work; the updated protocol has not yet been circulated to Elena.

decisions.nora_zone: string; use exactly 'quiet perimeter zone' when the accommodation is applied
decisions.quiet_hours_start: string; use exactly '09:00' when the accommodation is applied
decisions.handoff_recorded_incidents: integer; use exactly 3 for the three observed heated exchanges

acceptance_conditions: Nora must be placed in the quiet perimeter zone.
Quiet hours must begin at exactly 09:00.
The three observed heated exchanges must be recorded as exactly 3 incidents.
Nora and Imani must not resume unmediated one-to-one work.
Their working communication must use a written channel.
Their initial handoff meetings must be facilitated.
A neutral facilitator must be assigned.
The plan must explicitly document both the written communication requirement and a commitment to maintain the written communication channel.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Nora's accommodation changes nora_zone to exactly 'quiet perimeter zone' and quiet_hours_start to exactly '09:00'.
Imani's firsthand account changes handoff_recorded_incidents to exactly 3 and changes the initial coordination format to facilitated meetings.
The verified conduct protocol changes direct_one_to_one_allowed to false, requires written communication, requires a neutral facilitator, and requires documenting a written-communication commitment.
